mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, we are looking at overcast skies over at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 63 degrees.

The City of Verona has announced that trick-or-treat hours will be held on October 31st from 5 PM to 8 PM, and Mayor Diaz has recognized October 1st through 8th as Week Without Driving to support accessibility for all residents.
We have plenty of activities coming up, including Hop Haus Trivia today and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market taking place tomorrow at Hometown Junction Park.
In a report covering the end of September, officers handled a variety of calls, including an incident on September 21st where a subject was cited for retail theft involving candy.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for our flavor of the day, Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The restaurant is open and serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
